summary: This native Malaysian catfish was frequently called Hemibagrus nemurus in older literature. Modern revisions separate H. capitulum of Malaysia and neighbouring islands from the Java species H. nemurus.
nativeRange: The Malay Peninsula, Sumatra and Borneo.

features: Dorsal fin reaches the adipose-fin origin when laid flat against the body

habitat.description: River channels and covered stream margins, with verified records in tributaries of Kenyir and in Ulu Paip, Kedah.

eating: A commercially valuable freshwater food fish in Malaysia.
